courses.title: Corsi di Yoga, Tai Chi Chuan, Qi Gong e Cinque Tibetani
courses.description: Weekly body-practice classes at the centre alongside its Dharma programme: gentle and Hatha yoga, Tai Chi Chuan, Qi Gong and the Five Tibetans. Open to beginners of any age, they run from October to June, with a free trial lesson and centre membership required.

left_out: 'Intenzionalità di guarigione' and 'La meditazione come cura': videos with Prof. Gioacchino Pagliaro, handled with videos, not here.
Each discipline has no page of its own (all are on /corsi/), so they go in as one offering rather than five.
flags: The courses page says Qi Gong helps 'rafforzare la salute fisica e mentale e ridurre lo stress' (strengthen physical and mental health and reduce stress): general wellbeing, no condition named; kept under the new rule.
No price on the page (a free trial lesson, then centre membership); set to 'Contact for pricing'. Teachers are on /corsi/gli-insegnanti/, not the centre's lamas.
